{{Top|leg}}
'''Sand snakes''' were [[Hair/Legends|fur]]-covered [[Snake/Legends|snakes]] that were native to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Oddly, their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] were positioned in the center of their roughly three-[[Meter/Legends|meters]]-long body.

[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] once encountered a sand snake on Geonosis which was being fought over by two [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]]. When Fett came along, they dropped the sand snake for him. He then picked up a piece of [[Mica (mineral)|mica]], a rock as shiny as [[Glass/Legends|glass]], and threw it at one of the massiffs. The other massiff jumped for Fett, missed, and fell off the cliff at the other side.

A couple of days later, Fett found a sand snake following him, probably the same one he saved.
